TITLE: Board View – The Whole Page Scrolls, Although the PRD Lets Only the Columns Scroll
STATUS: FILED as SV-11720 23 Oct 2026; reopened by the QA lead 23 Oct after a brief "expected" ruling; title and description reworded at his request to say plainly what the PRD restricts and what happens. FILING APPROVED by the QA lead 23 Oct 2026 ("file a bug in fast follow"), as a Bug under SV-11593. Earlier: HELD — not filed. Owning story SV-10046 is Done (read live 22 Oct 2026 18:25 UTC); where it goes (Story Defect under SV-10046, or a Bug under the Fast Follow epic SV-11593) is the QA lead's decision. Ask per ticket (Rule 113).
Fields: Bug · parent SV-11593 (Board/Tech View Fast Follow) · Medium · Product Area Work Orders · labels board-tech-view, fast-follow · relates to SV-10046

h2. Description

*What the PRD requires:* in Board View the page itself must never scroll up or down — only the cards inside each column may scroll (PRD *S3-E1*: "The page itself does not scroll vertically; only the content inside each column does.").

*What happens instead:* on production the page itself has become scrollable. Turning the mouse wheel over an empty part of the board moves the whole page, and the toolbar (tabs, *Search*, filters, view switcher) slides off the top of the screen.

*Why the page can scroll now:*

* at a 1600 px wide window the row of tabs, *Search* and filters no longer fits since the *Technician* filter was added (SV-11326, Done 20 Oct 2026), so *Create Work Order* drops to a second line
* that pushes the board 56 px lower, so the page (1056 px) is taller than the window (1000 px) and has room to move
* the wheel over an empty area under a short column scrolls that extra space, taking the tabs, *Search*, the filters and the view switcher out of sight
* scrolling inside a column with many cards works correctly — only that column moves

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to production and check the top bar shows *Truck Hill 1*; use a browser window about 1600 × 1000.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, type {{ZZAUTOTEST F2 Column Scroll}} in *Search* and click *Board View*.
#* *Unassigned* holds many cards; the technician columns next to it are short or empty.
#* *Create Work Order* sits on its own line under the row of tabs and filters.
# Put the mouse over the empty area below a short column (e.g. under *Ayesha Khan*) and turn the wheel down.
#* The whole page moves up: the *All / Estimates / Work Orders / Completed* tabs, *Search*, the filters and the view switcher go off the top.

*Actual Result:*

* The page itself scrolls: one turn of the wheel moves the whole page by 56 px and the toolbar goes out of sight.

*Expected Result:*

* As the PRD requires (S3-E1), the page itself does not scroll; only the content inside each column scrolls.
